title: Deploy a Windows Service
description: Install or update a Windows service from the deployed package: sc.exe-compatible create/update, start mode, run-as account, dependencies, and desired post-deploy state.

Octopus.Action.WindowsService.ServiceNam.label: Service name
Octopus.Action.WindowsService.ServiceNam.helpText: Short service name (what sc.exe and net start use). Required.

Octopus.Action.WindowsService.DisplayNam.label: Display name
Octopus.Action.WindowsService.DisplayNam.helpText: Name shown in services.msc. Defaults to the service name.

Octopus.Action.WindowsService.Executable.label: Executable path
Octopus.Action.WindowsService.Executable.helpText: Path to the service executable. A relative path resolves against the package installation directory.

Octopus.Action.WindowsService.Arguments.label: Arguments
Octopus.Action.WindowsService.Arguments.helpText: Command-line arguments passed to the executable.

Octopus.Action.WindowsService.Dependenci.label: Dependencies
Octopus.Action.WindowsService.Dependenci.helpText: Service short names this service depends on, separated by forward slashes (e.g. LanmanWorkstation/TCPIP).

Octopus.Action.WindowsService.CustomAcco.label: Custom account name
Octopus.Action.WindowsService.CustomAcco.helpText: DOMAIN\user, .\user for a local account, or DOMAIN\user$ for a Managed Service Account.

Octopus.Action.WindowsService.CustomAcco.label: Custom account password
Octopus.Action.WindowsService.CustomAcco.helpText: Leave blank for a Managed Service Account.

Octopus.Action.Package.CustomInstallatio.label: Custom installation directory
Octopus.Action.Package.CustomInstallatio.helpText: Optional. When set, package contents are taken from this directory instead of the default extraction directory. Variable expressions are substituted.
